cost_quantity_requirements.notes: One exact Zombie Zero dispatch uses the owner-fixed zero-resource, zero-loss mechanic. No disclosure gates. Premium/refill is forbidden; own reward is one separate row claim. Three visit effects include an optional preset switch without extra reset allowance.

cooldown_deferred_behavior: Defer if current attempt state is busy or unavailable, the daily ordinal was already used, or the own reward is unavailable/already claimed; do not hardcode attempt availability or cooldown.
bounded_recovery_behavior: Persist attempt before dispatch and confirmed result/claim separately. Revalidate prior canonical attempt/result evidence without redispatch; any ambiguous or unresolved attempt, formation, result, reward row, claimed checkmark, reset identity, or Home blocks/manual-requires and never retries.

No win requirement or minimum damage threshold is inferred. No native acceptance, capture identifier, or live readiness is asserted.
